galaxy.canvas_label: The registry galaxy: every domain drawn as a cluster of subjects.
galaxy.rows_heading_council: Stars this council lands on, A to Z, {count}
galaxy.subject_footer: {count} TECHNIQUES · RANK 1 AT THE CENTRE, A TO Z OUTWARD
galaxy.legend_sky_body: One globular cluster per domain, packed so none collide and numbered in name order. The docked list prints the same numbers. The rim arc is council state.
galaxy.legend_domain_body: Categories are sub-discs, rank 1 nearest the core, A to Z outward. Disc area is how many subjects it holds.
galaxy.legend_category_body: The disc is cut into subcategory wedges, A to Z clockwise from twelve, sized by count. Inside a wedge, subjects spiral outward in name order.
galaxy.legend_subject_body: Techniques on a sunflower spiral: rank 1 at the centre, A to Z outward, sized by how many laws govern them. Hover one to light its law family.
galaxy.legend_lens_on: Lens on. It magnifies under the pointer without changing zoom.
galaxy.legend_lens_off: Lens off. Press L to magnify under the pointer without changing zoom.
galaxy.council_focus_body: The {lit} stars this council lands on are lit; the other {dimmed} are dimmed, never hidden. The docked list shows the same set, A to Z, with each one's council state.
galaxy.council_focus_escape: Escape restores the view you had before the council was opened.
galaxy.lens_hint: Magnify under the pointer without changing zoom (L)
galaxy.unpaired_description: The galaxy is drawn from a knowledge registry checkout. Pair one under Dev Tools, Workspaces, and this field fills itself.
galaxy.error_title: The registry could not be read
galaxy.corpus_empty: No council has reached this corpus yet. An unpainted galaxy is the honest first day.

bench.toggle_hint: Raise or drop the queue of councils waiting on you (Q)
bench.lede: The council escorts, it never approves. The instrument is uncalibrated, so judged floors are advisory; mechanical floors bind. The sky behind this bench is aimed at the stars the chosen subject touches.
bench.keys_hint: Up and down move, Enter sits at the table, Escape goes back to the sky
bench.group_yours_note: Escorted to the gate. Only you can approve or reject.
bench.group_machine_note: Passed by machine, or sent back to the builders.
bench.group_decided_note: Your past decisions, and whether the code has moved since.
bench.fixture_mode: Fixture mode. Decisions are held in memory and never reach the store.
bench.empty_description: A council runs from the feature ledger in Dev Tools. Once one lands, the subject it judged appears here with everything it found.
bench.failed_title: The councils could not be read

table.rose_label: The council members: wedge width is weight, reach is score, the ring is the threshold.
table.weight_line: {percent} of overall, drawn as the width of its wedge
table.state_not_run: Not measured: the council stopped before this member
table.not_measured_prose: The wedge is drawn hatched at full reach: the absence of a measurement is not a low score, and it contributes nothing to the overall.
table.rubric_unknown: This run names a rubric this build does not know ({version}). The figures are drawn against the {fallback} rubric, so read the weights with care.
table.why_floor_hit: {member} hit its floor ({score} under {floor}). The council stopped after the mechanical tier.
table.why_clears: {measured} of {total} members measured, no floor hit, and overall {overall} clears the {threshold} threshold by {margin}.
table.why_under: {measured} of {total} members measured, and overall {overall} is {margin} under the {threshold} threshold.
table.why_no_overall: No overall score: coverage {coverage} is under the {floor} floor.
table.run_failed_title: This round could not be read
table.no_run_title: No council has run on this subject
table.no_run_body: Run one from the feature ledger in Dev Tools and the whole round lands here.
table.why_unread: Overall {overall} against a threshold of {threshold}, coverage {coverage}. The members of this round have not been read yet.

gate.open_body: The council found nothing that stops this, and it may never approve. The decision is yours.
gate.reason_label: Why are you rejecting this? The builders read this sentence first.
gate.reason_placeholder: Write the reason in your own words
gate.reason_need: A written reason is required, {count} more characters.
gate.reason_ok: This is written into the round.
gate.focus_hint: G moves the focus to Approve. No key commits a decision.
gate.why_ready_standard: Ready, but a standard-tier feature passes by machine. Only major features and architecture redesigns reach a person.
gate.why_machine_pass: Machine pass. A standard-tier feature cleared the council on its own and is not waiting on you.
gate.why_stalled: Stalled at round {round}. The score stopped improving, so it goes back to the builders, not to you.
gate.why_incomplete: Incomplete. Coverage is {coverage}, under the {floor} floor, so no overall score exists yet. There is nothing to decide.
gate.why_fail: Failed a floor or a hard check. It goes back to the builders before it can reach you.
gate.why_approved: You approved this. The gate stays closed until the code drifts.
gate.why_approved_drifted: You approved this, and the code has changed since. A new council round is owed before this gate reopens.
gate.why_rejected: It reopens when a new round supersedes this one.
gate.why_none: No council has run on this subject.
gate.why_superseded: A later round has superseded this one. Only the latest round can be decided.
gate.moved: The council moved since you looked. The round on screen has been reloaded, and nothing was recorded.
gate.approved_toast: Approved. The stars it touches have changed state in the field above.
gate.rejected_toast: Rejected, with your reason on record.

evidence.heading: What the member actually looked at
evidence.media_missing: The file is not on disk at the path the run recorded.
